destination.name: Sunshine Coast Hinterland
destination.tagline: Waterfalls, rainforest walks and hill towns in the Blackall Range inland
destination.description: The Blackall Range rises just inland from the Sunshine Coast, with hill towns such as Maleny and Montville and a string of small national parks. Kondalilla National Park has 327 hectares of subtropical rainforest, with Kondalilla Falls dropping 90 m, and Mapleton Falls drops 120 m. The 58 km Sunshine Coast Hinterland Great Walk starts near Lake Baroon at Montville and takes four to six days. Maleny and Montville both have visitor centres, which makes the range an easy day trip from the beaches.
whyVisit: Walk to waterfalls in subtropical rainforest

goodToKnow.title: Book Great Walk campsites
goodToKnow.detail: Campsites on the Hinterland Great Walk have water, toilets and platforms, and must be booked ahead.

goodToKnow.title: Busy in school holidays
goodToKnow.detail: Waterfall parks such as Mapleton Falls can be crowded in the holidays, so arrive early or visit midweek.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} is the drier, cooler half of the year, better for rainforest walks and lookouts.
